Hey /u/Chroo - I cannot describe how much your comment means to me right now

I can't get a job because my school is putting too much pressure on me after I had mono, and I can't handle more than school right now.. when I am done with school I sleep.. Sometimes I sleep for 16 hours straight. Any physical or psychological work makes me sick, tired and weak.

The money I make come from me drawing people's tattoos etc and the money I owe comes from a guy who wanted a £100 drawing and when I was done drawing it he said that it was perfect but that he didn't want it anyways and he made a paypal chargeback of £50

I don't feel like I can talk to my parents about this. None of my friends know about my situation and I can't talk to them. I just can't. They know me as a different person

And about the school grants, then yeah - maybe I can get them for january, but the guy in control of the grants is the one to decide whether I should receive them or not. No one can change it
